purpose: Independent natural-target check of the declared grid-GP use case, not a replacement for the primary synthetic data. All Set12 images, not hand-picked examples. The structural Cartesian assumption remains and this is not a standard image-super-resolution SOTA comparison.
corpus: All PNG files in cszn/KAIR testsets/set12, pinned to the latest commit touching this path at protocol time; Git blob SHA and SHA256 for each file will be saved in research/external_corpus_manifest.json. No files selected by scores or timing.
preprocessing: Decode grayscale PNG to float64 [0,1]. Training rows=round(linspace(0,H-1,128)), columns=round(linspace(0,W-1,64)); all 8192 pair combinations. Normalize coordinates by H-1,W-1. Add independent Gaussian noise std 0.05 to training luminance. Held-out 512 original pixel locations sampled uniformly WITHOUT replacement from pixels outside training grid, RNG 10000+seed; add independent std-0.05 observation noise. No training pixel is evaluated as test.
kernel_and_quality: exactly the primary frozen kernel, centering and RMSE/mean/variance/NLL tolerances; no external-test-driven tuning or hyperparameter optimization
baseline: dense_fortran complete-grid GP, one-pass kernel construction and LAPACK, independently validated against original frozen dense
method: NumPy-only full-rank tensor spectral GP, no truncation
endpoint: fresh process from spawn to exit including imports, PNG decode, training/test selection and deterministic noise generation, centering, kernel/fit, all posterior mean+variance predictions, held-out metrics and output serialization
order: fixed randomized image/seed/repeat plan, counterbalanced per pair, RNG seed 123456
inclusion: Every corpus image and seed. If an image is too small or unavailable, log failure; do not replace it with a favorable image. Preserve any unfinished cases if budget is exhausted.
uncertainty: ratio of summed cold times, 10000 bootstrap replicates clustered by image (not by duplicate timing repetitions or shared-image seeds)
caveat: The dataset/task domain is still regular-grid spatial interpolation. This does NOT prove a data-agnostic 10x improvement, nor avoid that structural domain restriction. A strict requirement for unstructured data is not satisfied by this result.
